corpus.json.source: 113 Kitsu entries — every multi-episode pick recorded under hianime/picker/ and every other show checked while looking for numbering disagreements — each with the Kitsu status and episode count (GET /anime/:id), AniList's status, episode count and next episode for the MAL id Kitsu maps it to (Page(media(idMal_in:))), the Kitsu episode pages the evidence reader asks for that count (/anime/:id/episodes, 20 to a page, sorted by number; [number, canonicalTitle, airdate]), the entries Kitsu relates it to (/anime/:id/media-relationships, reduced to [role, type, id, subtype, status, episodeCount, and for a TV entry related in any role whose Kitsu episode list was fetched, its first page of titles]) with whether that page held them all, and the picked hianime listing (/api/theme/episode/list/:id through the impersonating transport) reduced by script to [slot, data-number, title] with the title's entities decoded. Fetched on 2026-10-17 and 2026-10-18, paced (hianime ≥3 s apart, Kitsu ≥1.2 s, AniList ≥1.5 s). `appended` marks the three whose listings append extras after Kitsu's last episode.
